    All Classes and Interfaces

    Description

    Ability scores used by characters.

    Entry point of the Ashen Shield application.

    Utility class for exporting battle logs.
    BattleMenuFactory
    Factory for the battle menu bar.

    Listener for battle menu actions.

    Main combat screen for Ashen Shield.
    BattlePanelListener
    Listener for battle screen events and battle-log integration.

    Shared combat calculations and text descriptions.
    BattleSheetDialogs
    Utility methods for battle sheet dialogs.
    BattleShortcutInstaller
    Utility class for battle keyboard shortcuts.
    BattleShortcutListener
    Listener for keyboard shortcuts used on the battle screen.
    CampaignEnemyFactory
    Creates the ordered enemy list for a campaign run.
    CharacterClass
    Playable character classes.
    CharacterCreationListener
    Listener for character creation screen events.
    CharacterCreationPanel
    Screen used to create a new player character.
    CharacterCreationRules
    Character creation catalog and bonus rules.
    CharacterLoadDialog
    Utility class for loading saved characters through a file chooser.
    CharacterPersistenceService
    Abstraction for saving and loading characters.
    DamageRoll
    Result of a player damage roll, including text used in the battle log.
    DefeatPanel
    Screen shown when the player character is defeated.
    DefeatPanelListener
    Listener for defeat screen actions.
    DiceRoller
    Rolls dice used by combat rules.
    Difficulty
    Campaign difficulty mode.
    Enemy
    Represents an enemy encountered during combat.
    GameCharacter
    Represents the playable character created by the user.
    GuiUtils
    Utility class for shared Swing helper methods used by multiple panels.

    HighScoreService
    Service class for saving and loading high scores from a text file.

    Main application window that controls panel navigation.

    Listener for actions raised from the main menu screen.
    MainMenuPanel
    Main menu screen of the application.

    Calculates player weapon damage rolls.
    Race
    Playable character races.
    RestService
    Utility class for rest and healing rules.
    SaveLoadService
    Service class responsible for saving and loading characters with Java serialization.
    ShortRestResult
    Result of a short rest action.
    StatAllocation
    Handles point-buy stat allocation and race bonuses during character creation.
    StatAllocationPanel
    Panel responsible for point-buy stat allocation during character creation.
    Stats
    Stores the six ability scores used by the character.

    Screen shown after the player defeats an enemy.
